narr: Slow moving and training thunderstorms moved across central Mississippi during the morning hours of July 19th. Heavy rainfall resulted in flash flooding across portions of east central Mississippi.
ev: Flooding occurred on Marion Russell Road.
Roads and yards were flooded in the Tanglewood Community.
Portions of county road 317 were impassible due to flash flooding.
Flooding occurred on Highway 19 in the northern part of the county.
Several roads were inundated with flood waters in the city of Union.
